context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified: Admin Designs page now loads correctly. The fix involved: 1) AuthContext.js now stores JWT token in localStorage after login/register, 2) CORS configuration updated. All Design API endpoints working: GET /api/designs, GET /api/admin/designs, POST /api/admin/designs, PUT /api/admin/designs/{id}, DELETE /api/admin/designs/{id}, POST /api/admin/designs/upload. Frontend Admin Designs page displays designs in two sections (Apparel and Hats), Add Design form has all required fields, delete button appears on hover.
